---
title: "Single-trait models"
format: html
---

Use `stblr_bed()` for individual-level `bayesc`, `bayesr`, or `bayesrc`.
Use `stblr_csr()` for summary-statistics `sbayesc` or `sbayesr`, and
`stblr_block_eigen()` for `sbayesc`, `sbayesr`, or `sbayesrc`.

`stblr_csr_annot()` owns fixed-marker, group, learned-logistic, and
annotation-probit-stick summary-statistics policies. Effective marker effects
are reported as `bm` and final `b_final`; `dm` is posterior non-null
probability. Trait variance traces are `vbs`, `vgs`, `ves`, `vle`, and `vld`.
